$comment: Cheap, git-history-free guards whose verdict depends on main. Run by scripts/queue-drift-precheck.mjs against a test merge of the PR with the latest main before Merge Queue Green Enroll enqueues it. Add a guard here only if it is node-only (no pnpm install), finishes in seconds, and counts or ratchets something other PRs also move. A guard whose `requires` paths are absent is skipped, so a guard can be listed before it lands.

guards.remediation: Run `pnpm doc:freshness:check` after merging main and fix the drift it names.
Run `node scripts/data-architecture-guard.mjs` after merging main; shrink the ratchet, never raise it.
Run `node scripts/workflow-token-budget-guard.mjs` after merging main and reconcile the GITHUB_TOKEN ratchet.
Run `node scripts/external-api-guard.mjs` after merging main and route new provider calls through packages/api-client.
